name: Ray-Mesh Intersection Sampling with Priority Material Assignment
definition: A method to determine the material at each sample point by intersecting the view ray with organ meshes, decomposing the ray into segments between intersections, and assigning materials based on a priority hierarchy to handle overlapping meshes.
summary: Ray-Mesh Intersection Sampling with Priority Material Assignment assigns materials to ray segments based on a strict hierarchy to ensure smooth organ boundaries and avoid staircase artifacts.
